The MSTA burns steam back into EU — the pack's only true power plant. Efficiency caps by grade: plain §1150%§r, dense §1200%§r, supercritical §1250%§r, dense supercritical §1300%§r.

Supply priority is written in stone: §3dense supercritical > supercritical > dense superheated > dense > superheated > plain§r; dense and supercritical further demand a §1tier-6§r hull.

§cThe explosion clause is equally stone-written: total dynamo output below the demanded EU, and it blows on the spot.§r
